summary: All stage 3a notebook semantic checks passed. The notebook presents BADGE as a single-method tutorial, cites the relevant paper elements, and executes acquisition, global-index bookkeeping, fresh retraining, and post-round evaluation coherently.

checks_summary.note: The executed demo's evaluation path reports test accuracy and the smoke run is intended to verify it exceeds multiclass chance.
Section 4 describes predicted-label gradient embeddings and sequential k-MEANS++ and the shown code executes those paths.
Equation (1), Section 3, Algorithm 1, and Appendix A Algorithm 2 citations match the paper-map locations.
The loop trains a model and computes post-acquisition test accuracy on every completed round.
build_model is called inside every acquisition round before train_from_scratch.
Returned pool positions are mapped through unlabeled_idx and selected items are removed from the unlabeled set via labeled_idx bookkeeping.
The initial state is evaluated once and each configured round performs one acquisition followed by one evaluation.
The notebook's ranking explanation is consistent with k-MEANS++ sampling by squared distance from the nearest selected center.

caveats: The notebook is intentionally smoke-scaled and explicitly discloses the reduced pool/round budget, one seed, and demo MLP instead of the paper's full benchmark protocol.
